subject: Ciências
description_pt: Discutir a evolução e a diversidade das espécies com base na atuação da seleção natural sobre as variantes de uma mesma espécie, resultantes de processo reprodutivo.

components.description_pt: Explicar como a seleção natural causa traços hereditários vantajosos à sobrevivência aumentarem em frequência entre gerações
components.description_en: Explain how natural selection causes heritable traits advantageous to survival to increase in frequency over generations
components.cc_component_description: Explain how natural selection causes heritable traits advantageous to survival to increase in frequency over generations

components.description_pt: Identificar como processos reprodutivos geram variantes dentro de uma espécie
components.description_en: Identify how reproductive processes generate variants within a species
components.cc_component_description: Identify heritable variations in characteristics among individuals within a species

components.description_pt: Construir uma explicação de como a seleção natural agindo sobre variação de traços leva à mudança de espécie ao longo do tempo
components.description_en: Construct an explanation for how natural selection acting on trait variation leads to species change over time
components.cc_component_description: Construct an explanation for how natural selection acting on trait variation leads to species change over time

cc_matches.description: Adaptation by natural selection acting over generations is one important process by which species change over time in response to changes in environmental conditions. Traits that support successful survival and reproduction in the new environment become more common; those that do not become less common. Thus, the distribution of traits in a population changes.
Use evidence to construct an explanation for how the variations in characteristics among individuals of the same species may provide advantages in surviving, finding mates, and reproducing.
